offering_description.value: Provides home-based care products and services for chronic conditions such as diabetes, sleep health, wound care, respiratory care, urology and ostomy. Sells to patients and their insurers, delivering equipment and supplies to the home through its Apria and Byram Healthcare brands.

quotes.quote: Backed by the industry-leading expertise of our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health provides patients with critical products, services, and support to manage their health, helping to improve outcomes for millions of people each year.
Accendra Health is reimagining the future of home-based care with one of the broadest portfolios of essentials for diabetes, sleep health, wound care, respiratory care, urology, and ostomy.

quotes.quote: At Accendra Health (formerly known as Owens & Minor, Inc.), care is a promise. A promise of peace of mind, a promise of confidence, and a commitment to connecting patients, providers, and insurers so healthcare works better for everyone.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials. We overcome obstacles. We educate and provide answers. We make it possible for patients and families to access healthcare when and where they need it, helping to improve outcomes for millions of people each year who receive care at home.
